converse.emptyText: Pick a graph and start the conversation.
converse.emptyVoice: Press start and say something. What you say appears as you speak it.
converse.halfDuplexHelp: Stops the microphone while the assistant talks. Use it if the assistant interrupts itself through your speakers; headphones solve the same problem.
converse.insecureContext: A microphone needs a secure context. localhost works; a LAN address over plain http:// does not — use https or open the UI on the machine itself.
converse.requires: Needs a microphone and the voice graph running: skills/asr, skills/llm-chat, skills/sentence-chunker and skills/tts.
converse.voiceGraphHelp: Voice runs the `voice` graph: speech to text, a model, a sentence chunker and speech synthesis, all at once.

config.restartRequiredHint: Changing this only takes effect the next time the skill process starts.

studio.badRef: "{{ref}}" is not a usable ref: lowercase letters, digits, - and _, and not already taken.
studio.cannotSplice: {{name}} has no input or no output, so nothing can pass through it.
studio.copiedIR: Graph IR copied to the clipboard.
studio.empty: State a goal above. The planner picks the skills, compiles a graph, and it appears here — then lights up as it runs.
studio.hint: Pick a skill from the palette, or state a goal above and let the planner build one. Drag an output port to an input to wire an edge. Shift-drag to box-select, scroll to zoom.

history.empty: Nothing registered yet. A version is recorded the first time this graph is registered, and again whenever its content changes.
history.note: Loading a version does not roll the node back. Register it and the history gains an entry saying you went back — which is what happened.
history.restored: Loaded version #{{n}} onto the canvas. Register it to make it current.
history.title: {{graph}} — every version registered

inspector.clientNote: The client pseudo-node is the external application connection. C2 implies it from the edges that name it, so it is never written into nodes[] and cannot be removed.
inspector.deadlineHelp: How long a delivery here is worth waiting for. Absolute once on the wire; a later hop may tighten it, never extend it.
inspector.gateHelp: human-approval holds the message until a person confirms. Node policy may add one regardless; a graph can ask for more scrutiny, never less.
inspector.gateMotorHelp: This destination acts on the world. C2 rule 5 means the kernel adds a human-approval gate when none is declared — in published mode it refuses the session instead.
inspector.nothing: Select a node or an edge to see what it declares.
inspector.priorityHelp: Higher wins when two chains contend for the same skill.
inspector.qosRealtime: datagram; cannot stall or be stalled
inspector.qosReliable: one ordered stream, FIFO per edge
inspector.refHelp: This node's local name inside the graph. Lowercase, digits, dash or underscore.
inspector.resolveHelp: A demand the kernel satisfies at instantiation. Prefer this over a package: it lets the node degrade to another provider.
inspector.speculativeHelp: Deliver on partial upstream output and discard the work if the final output differs. Refused into a motor skill, and refused alongside a human-approval gate.
inspector.useHelp: Pin an exact package instead of a capability. Overrides resolve.
